polishes.description: Be yourself and Espresso Your Holo. Show your love for a bold crushed holographic look in this deep espresso shade with a heavy sprinkling of holographic micro-flakes. How much coffee do you need before you can express yourself?

polishes.description: This Fairy Tail can be your reality. Coat your claws in this rich brown-taupe shade and create a soft cat-eye effect with your Magic Wand. A cozy bronze hue makes dreams come true.

polishes.name: Fairy Tail
polishes.description: Picture this: crisp autumn air, crunching leaves underfoot, and a multichromatic topper on your nails. Filled with asymmetrical foil flakes that shift between copper, green, and magenta hues, Fallen Flake Taco will transform any mani into the perfect foliage fantasy. No raking [peelies] required.

polishes.name: Fake Date
polishes.description: Bring a Fake Date home for the holodays! This metallic frosty lilac polish is packed with enough reflective foil pigments to fool your friends and family into asking where you got that nail polish all night.

polishes.name: Fallen Flake Taco
polishes.description: Picture this: crisp autumn air, crunching leaves underfoot, and a multichromatic topper on your nails. Filled with asymmetrical foil flakes that shift between copper, green, and magenta hues, Fallen Flake Taco will transform any mani into the perfect foliage fantasy. No raking [peelies] required.

polishes.name: Fallen Flake Taco (birthday Gift
polishes.description: This warm deep green didn’t fall Far From the Tree—it branched out. A crushed holographic in a shade suited for discovery, it proves the best ideas come when you dare to grow differently.

polishes.name: Favourite Sister
polishes.description: **DOES NOT INCLUDE LIMITED EDITION BOX** She is my Favourite Sister… who also happens to be my only sister. Designed by Simply Nailogical’s sister Jen, this bright red frosted metal polish is fit for a blood relative. Make your nails reflect like red foil with a sprinkle of scattered holo so you can one-up all other siblings.

polishes.name: Featured Guest
polishes.description: **DOES NOT INCLUDE LIMITED EDITION BOX**Everyone please take several seats, our Featured Guest has arrived. This is the white linear holo of your dreams. A subtle dove grey, nearly-white crelly base with a delicate dose of holographic flair, this nail polish is truly an event your nails won’t want to miss.

polishes.name: Feeling Fiendish
polishes.description: Treat your nails to a 21st century makeover with Feeling Fiendish. This muted deep mauve-magenta crème applies like a dream and reaches full coverage with just two curious coats. Perfect for matching both your behaviour and wardrobe.

polishes.name: Feeling Sparks
polishes.description: Ever seen a bonfire in a bottle? Get ready to feel ALL the sparks when you swipe on this deep burgundy-red polish that transforms with a magic stick. With flaming amber magnetic sparks and iridescent orange flakes that flicker like embers, sparks are sure to fly.

polishes.name: Feral Forest
polishes.description: The woods are lovely, dark and deep… and so is this lush evergreen crelly. It’s rich and buildable, and it gets denser and denser with every coat. So, we’ll leave the exploring up to you: how far into the Feral Forest will you wander?

polishes.name: Fifty Shades of Greige
polishes.description: What could be more appealing than Fifty Shades of Greige? This understated beauty of a pale linear holo was initially created as a test case by mixing all of the Pastel Rainbow linear polishes together. Tough to fit in a rainbow vibe, and not a match for the Barista set formula, this misfit is finally getting its moment. Consider it fashionably late.

polishes.name: Flakie Holo Taco
polishes.description: Retain all the nail art techniques in your memory with Flash Drive! This multichromatic shade beams so many purple vibes it may take up a few gigabytes of space. Eject this bright royal purple polish from your storage drawer and travel out of the boring nail zone.

polishes.name: Flakie Holo Taco™
polishes.description: Transform any base colour into holo using this topper with tiny holographic flakes! The asymmetrical holo flakies offer a dazzling sparkle with an edge that can’t be missed.

polishes.name: Flash Drive
polishes.description: We Foreshadow this polish will be a fave among the outsiders. Reject conventional shade norms and match the esteemed flagstone floors with this medium warm grey crème. We can’t deny giving extra credit for creamy coverage.

polishes.name: Flirt Alert
polishes.description: Be honest, this hot pink had you at hello. A flirty raspberry-pink magnetic with a wink of scattered holo that’s anything but innocent.

polishes.name: Foiled Again
polishes.description: A tale as old as time: green polishes getting Foiled Again. While in the process of creating the Holo Royalty Debut Trio, this shade was royally rejected after Holo Royalty customers voted in three pink and purple shades instead. We kinda think they were wrong and are giving this bright and festive frosted metal another shot.

polishes.name: Foreshadow
polishes.description: We Foreshadow this polish will be a fave among the outsiders. Reject conventional shade norms and match the esteemed flagstone floors with this medium warm grey crème. We can’t deny giving extra credit for creamy coverage.

polishes.name: Foreshadow (birthday Gift
polishes.description: It’s your turn to experience Freezer Burn. Top a dark mani with one coat of this bold blue iridescent shimmer for a look so cool you’ll see your breath. Or, think outside of the icebox and layer this topper over a lighter base for a seared yellow finish.

polishes.name: Frost Light
polishes.description: Light up the night with sparkling frosty tips! This icy blue holographic glitter polish is packed with micro, small, and medium-sized silver and blue holographic glitters in a tinted light blue jelly base. Like a cold winter day in a bottle, but it won’t give you frost bite!

polishes.name: Frozen Benanas
polishes.description: What’s for dessert? Frozen Benanas. Inspired by Ben’s eternal love of bananas, this metallic foil polish is an apeeling golden treat for your tips. Packed with yellow-gold reflective foil flakes and a surprise of scattered holo, you may find yourself staring into your nails because you never looked so good.

polishes.name: Full Charge
polishes.description: We love it when our nails hit Full Charge. This electric lime green polish is wired with linear holographic pigment. You won’t need a battery backup with this shade.

polishes.name: Funny Feeling
polishes.description: We have a Funny Feeling your nails are going to love this polish. Cast aside nail hesitation for a one-of-a-kind colour-changing mani. This serene turquoise shade with a hint of shimmer and scattered holo becomes a shockingly chartreuse yellow when exposed to warmer temps. Isn’t it fun to keep everybody guessing?

polishes.name: Galactic Unicorn Skin
polishes.description: What’s a cozy escape without a little glitter? This scattered floral topper adds the perfect finishing touch to any base. It’s like having a mini garden on each nail (that’s in bloom all year round).

polishes.name: Galactic Unicorn Skin™
polishes.description: This topper might come from another galaxy but it can exist on your nails! Galactic Unicorn Skin is an iridescent flakie topper that lights up nails with an electric green glow. Over a dark base, the translucent asymmetrical flakies will shift in colour from a bright green to a hint of purple. Over a light base, they appear pink with pops of yellow.

polishes.name: Garden Party Taco
polishes.description: What’s a cozy escape without a little glitter? This scattered floral topper adds the perfect finishing touch to any base. It’s like having a mini garden on each nail (that’s in bloom all year round).

polishes.name: Garden Party Taco (birthday Gift
polishes.description: Sometimes the only thing better than a gift is a Gift Receipt! This stunning sterling polish is packed with silver metallic foil to give it a polished and reflective finish as smooth as your gift giving skills.

polishes.name: Gift Receipt
polishes.description: Sometimes the only thing better than a gift is a Gift Receipt! This stunning sterling polish is packed with silver metallic foil to give it a polished and reflective finish as smooth as your gift giving skills.

polishes.name: Gift Receipt (birthday Gift
polishes.description: Your nails are about to look Ginger Snatched. Spice up your mani and expand your palette with this cozy tasteful gingerbread brown crème. Currently accepting applicants to take the cinnamon challenge at your nail polish desk.

polishes.name: Girly Ghoul
polishes.collection: Crushed-Holographic Holo Taco X Safiya Volume Ii (sep)
polishes.description: Get in touch with your inner Girly Ghoul with this icy lilac shade. A sweetheart crushed holo formula laced with blue microshimmer to lift your spirits.

polishes.name: Glamethyst
polishes.description: Put some pressure on glitter and shimmer and a Glamethyst is born. Rule all sides of sparkle with this light purple glitter polish and dazzle your subjects with its complimentary green shimmer. The end result? Priceless. ** THIS POLISH IS LIMITED EDITION **

polishes.name: Glazed Over
polishes.collection: Originally mixed for our Underglow Declassified Tacos 002 (dec)
polishes.description: Just a couple swipes and you’ll be Glazed Over. Originally mixed for our Underglow Collection, this glimmering white iridescent polish had too much multi-colour personality it had to venture out on its own. A rainbow icing, a sparkling snow coat, or a not-so-neutral neutral lacquer, we didn’t want you to miss out on a shade that’ll sweeten your mani up.

polishes.name: Glitch and Glam
polishes.description: There are glitterally more than ten different types of holo glitter in this nail polish. We mixed all our holographic glitter polishes together for the ultimate glitter remix... and surprise surprise, it’s purple! Sitting in a sweet purple grape jelly base, Glitterally Purple is jam-packed with 100% holographic glitters, the perfect fit for those that want literally all the glitter.

polishes.name: Glitterally Purple
polishes.description: Get Glossed & Found in a fresh coat of this watermelon-pink jelly. Its juicy, high-shine payoff will have you wishing this was lip gloss.

polishes.name: Glossed & Found
polishes.description: Trick or treat… turn off the lights and play nail tricks on peeps. Add some Glow In The Dark Taco to your mani and tell a scary story with your tips.

polishes.name: Glossy Taco™
polishes.description: The best 10-free quick-drying top coat you know and love, with the right balance of quick-dry speed and a glass-like glossy seal for long-lasting polish protection.

polishes.name: Glow in the Dark Taco
polishes.description: Feeling fancy? Just add a coat of Gold Flake Taco. The unique metallic golden flakes in this topper are guaranteed to transform any mani into nails worth more than gold. Does not cost $100,000.

polishes.name: Going Solo
polishes.description: The perks of Going Solo. Rock on to your own tune with this blackened crushed holo shade with a jolt of blue iridescence. A black licorice-coded shade with enough holographic sparkles in it to crush the darkest of souls.

polishes.name: Gold Flake Taco
polishes.description: Feeling fancy? Just add a coat of Gold Flake Taco. The unique metallic golden flakes in this topper are guaranteed to transform any mani into nails worth more than gold. Does not cost $100,000.

polishes.name: Gold Flake Taco (birthday Gift
polishes.description: All that glitters on our nails is gold holo! Gold Flakie Holo Taco is a limited edition flakie topper from the Holo Taco 1st Anniversary Collection — paint over any base polish to give your nails a glisten of gold holo!

polishes.name: Gold Flakie Holo Taco
polishes.collection: Gold Flakie Holo Taco is a limited edition flakie topper from the Holo Taco 1st Anniversary 1st Anniversary (summer)

polishes.name: Gold Flakie Taco
polishes.description: **This is the last season this polish will be restocked. Once it sells out, it will join our Retirement Rack.** Your nails will be so highly viewed after wearing this polish that you’ll deserve your own Gold Play Button. This true gold holographic glitter polish is packed with three different sizes of gold holographic glitter in a slightly tinted yellow-gold jelly base to let the gold holo glitters show through for maximum top-of-the-Cristmas tree impact. We didn’t count, but there could be 1 million holos in this bottle.

polishes.name: Gold Scattered Holo Taco
polishes.description: Gosh Garnet, what a true beauty! Snatch this Garnet-inspired polish for its luscious, deep burgundy smooth metallic sophistication inspired by the empowering birthstone of January. Indulge in a couple coats for a deeply intense manicure and admire its subtle red-bronze shimmer shift that complements the lighting of your surroundings. A solid start any time of year.

polishes.name: Got Cake
polishes.description: You’ve got Grape Expectations for your next mani, and we’re here for it. This juicy purple is bold and squishy on its own or layered up in a combo for a full PB&J moment.

polishes.name: Got Cake?
polishes.description: Have your cake and paint it, too… because this favourite shade is back by popular demand! It’s like icing for your nails. A multi-dimensional polish packed with holo flakies, silver foil flakes, and purple iridescent shimmer that’ll have you asking Got Cake? Wear it on its own for an icy nail treat, or try a single coat over One-Coat Black for a striking look that will be the life of the after-party!

polishes.name: Grape Expectations
polishes.description: Help yourself to the inedible Holo Cappuccino of your dreams. The recipe is no secret: this coffee inspired crushed holographic polish reflects rainbows in the light because it’s jam-packed with holographic micro-flakes. Wake up, there’s holo!

polishes.name: Green Screen
polishes.description: The key to a successful meeting is Green Screen! If you’ve been searching for that full-coverage true green crème polish, you’re in luck. Bonus: swipe Green Screen on your nails and turn your nails into whatever you want with your digital skills.

polishes.name: Green Taffy
polishes.description: Boring nails are green with envy! The holo is powerful in this vibrant true green polish packed with linear holographic pigment. The only thing Green Taffy is getting stuck to is your nails!

polishes.name: Greyt
polishes.description: It’s always a Greyt day to treat yourself to some new nails. This shiny shade of dark metallic grey is slick and sleek like a greyhounds’ coat gleaming in the sun. May cause spontaneous zoomies.

polishes.name: Grim Keeper
polishes.collection: Holo-Taco-X-Safiya-Volume-Two Holo Taco X Safiya Volume Ii (sep)
polishes.description: Dug up from the depths of your darkest era. Bring out your inner Grim Keeper by layering two to three coats of this grungy deep mauve with a blue micro-shimmer that plays peek-a-BOO.

polishes.name: Guilty Pleasure
polishes.description: We’re not going to lie—nail polish is our Guilty Pleasure. Indulge in this perfect shimmering orchid purple thermal polish that swings into a contrasting warm flamingo pink when things get heated. Painting our nails, changing our mood… we just can’t help it.

polishes.name: Halogen Glow
polishes.description: Go off like a lightbulb. One coat of Halogen Glow over a dark base will transform your nails with a pop of pale yellow-pink-green glimmer. Try this iridescent shimmer topper over a naked nail for a look like you’re glowing from within. Edison could never!

polishes.name: Happily Ever Aqua
polishes.description: You deserve to live Happily Ever Aqua. Choose your mani destiny with a polish inspired by the powerful positivity of March's birthstone. This pale aquamarine linear holo provides a serene painting experience while simultaneously generating inner tranquility with its glistening cyan shimmer. Your future is in your hands.

polishes.name: Head Hunter
polishes.description: We believe you’ve been spotted by a Head Hunter. Stand out in this lush, impressively opaque dark hunter green crème that’s equipped for the institution of life. No wonder they’re scouting your mani talents.

polishes.name: Heavy Metal Mixtape
polishes.description: Be careful with your nails because this Heavy Metal Mixtape is a real banger. This unique metallic foil polish is the result of mixing several frosted metal polishes: a carbon steel reflective finish with the most subtle dark purple icy undertone. Brb locking ourselves in our room to jam out with this track!

polishes.name: Herb Your Enthusiasm
polishes.description: Don’t curb your colour cravings. Herb Your Enthusiasm serves up rich sage in a sleek metallic finish. It’s anything but a garnish.

polishes.name: Here for the Payday
polishes.description: Work can be fun but sometimes it’s okay to be Here For The Payday. This bright chartreuse green crème polish is sure to stand out at the all-hands meeting. When the job description involves colour, you’ll excel with this bright and unique shade.

polishes.name: Hi-def
polishes.description: Pull up a bubble chair because we need to watch the latest chick flick in Hi-Def. This shade of yellow jelly polish with scattered holo is almost as shocking as our recent leaps in technology. Standard-definition nails who?

polishes.name: High Tea Hibiscus
polishes.description: Welcome to the tea party, would you like some High Tea Hibiscus? This sophisticated magenta crème is the highlight of your royal palette with its rich hibiscus-hue. Simply apply and be like “don’t mind me, I’m just Queen of the Tea”.

polishes.name: Highest Bidder
polishes.description: Going once, going twice… this nail polish is sold to the Highest Bidder. Not to worry—we capped the cost of this stunning silver-grey scattered holographic shade. Make a statement with hundreds of holographic micro-flakes that glow under the light like a true showstopper on the red carpet.

polishes.name: Hit the Lights
polishes.description: Sparkle that never sleeps. Hit The Lights and let gold reflective glitters shine through the deep indigo night sky.

polishes.name: Holo Cappuccino
polishes.description: Help yourself to the inedible Holo Cappuccino of your dreams. The recipe is no secret: this coffee inspired crushed holographic polish reflects rainbows in the light because it’s jam-packed with holographic micro-flakes. Wake up, there’s holo!

polishes.name: Holo Cappuccino (birthday Gift
polishes.description: Meet the most magical Holo Taco we’ve ever released. Silver holographic pigments suspended in a clear base, this magnetic topper reacts to your magnet to create a constellation of sparkle across your nails.

polishes.name: Holo Magnetic Taco
polishes.description: Are your nails on fire, or are you just happy to see us? Paint on a Hot Take for a searing hot orange-red mani that makes a statement. Nobody can argue with the full coverage of this crème.

polishes.name: Hot Take
polishes.description: Are your nails on fire, or are you just happy to see us? Paint on a Hot Take for a searing hot orange-red mani that makes a statement. Nobody can argue with the full coverage of this crème.

polishes.name: Hot Take (birthday Gift
polishes.description: When the holo is so strong it can Hot-Wire Pink a motor vehicle. This hot pink polish is like a joyride in a pink sports car on a rainbow road. Powered by 100% real linear holographic pigments.

polishes.name: Hot-wire Pink
polishes.description: Tell curious space invaders I’m Rover It. This beaming red-rock shade shimmers like rare volcanic glass rocks on a Mars horizon. Apply two to three coats of this warm hue and watch its added holographic micro-flakes land on the surface of your nails. Beautiful manis are from Mars!

polishes.name: Hydropower
polishes.description: Paint your nails for that Hydropower drip. This unique aqua linear holographic polish will have your eyeballs riding the holo waves on loop. That’s some big holo energy.

polishes.name: Hyper Punch
polishes.description: A shade that slaps back. Packed with juicy rainbow fruit-like pigments, Hyper Punch hits hard with knockout-level linear holographic flare.

polishes.name: I'm Live
polishes.description: Broadcasting LIVE from these hands, it’s you, looking so damn good in purple. I’m Live is a cool-toned violet crème polish that will instantly improve your gaming skills and won’t judge you as the sun comes up during your villager hunt marathon.

polishes.name: I'm Over Brew
polishes.description: Boring nails? I’m Over Brew! This classic dark burgundy shade is rooibos-ready and a must have for all the vampy-vibe lovers out there. The perfect colour to wear this fall… or any time of year, it’s not that steep!

polishes.name: I'm Rover It
polishes.description: Tell curious space invaders I’m Rover It. This beaming red-rock shade shimmers like rare volcanic glass rocks on a Mars horizon. Apply two to three coats of this warm hue and watch its added holographic micro-flakes land on the surface of your nails. Beautiful manis are from Mars!

polishes.name: I'm Rover It (birthday Gift
polishes.description: The celeb sighting of the summer. Everyone’s talking about Icon on Board—how could they not? Hot pink, semi-translucent, not quite a jelly, not quite a crème… and definitely not a nepo baby. This icon earned its name.

polishes.name: In a Flurry
polishes.description: In your peelings? Us too. This bright orange marmalade jelly delivers pure zest and sunshine in a bottle.

polishes.name: In My Peelings
polishes.description: Vibe out with an intense Jam Session. Riff on the traditional mani formula with this juicy red-coral shade of crushed holo featuring flashy magenta micro-shimmer. Then tap out your next rhythm on the keyboard with your punchy new tips.

polishes.name: Indigo Away
polishes.description: When you need some me-time with your nail polish, other people better Indigo Away! This deep purple indigo creme polish is the perfect dark base to wear alone or under a special effects topper.

polishes.name: Inkwell
polishes.description: Meet a shade mightier than the sword: Inkwell. Dip your quill into this blackened sepia polish with a rich bronze shimmer that mimics the flicker of candlelight. Time to enter your dark prose era and write home about it.

polishes.name: Inside Job
polishes.description: Behold a polish so peculiar… it must have been an Inside Job. Set in a lush purple jelly, its endless supply of holographic glitters and special square glitters shine like the richest gems in the safe. Perfect for pointing your manicured fingers at literally any other suspects.** THIS POLISH IS LIMITED EDITION **

polishes.name: Iron Violet
polishes.description: File, prep and paint your nails purple to become a true Iron Violet champion. This cool-toned purple chrome shade captures the crowd as it bolts past the finish line. Just one coat and you’ve nailed the look.

polishes.name: Ivory Tower
polishes.description: Pursue a theoretical mani blank slate from an Ivory Tower. This off-white crème serves towering opacity for a light shade, so removed from most light polishes out there. What does it have that other light crèmes don’t? Knowledge is power, and so is its coverage.

polishes.name: Ivy League
polishes.description: Turn heads and take joy in other people’s envy in Ivy League. This buildable blackened green jelly polish has scintillating flashes of evergreen shimmer so elite it's hard to compete. Welcome to the big leagues.

polishes.name: Jam Session
polishes.description: Vibe out with an intense Jam Session. Riff on the traditional mani formula with this juicy red-coral shade of crushed holo featuring flashy magenta micro-shimmer. Then tap out your next rhythm on the keyboard with your punchy new tips.

polishes.name: Jam Session (birthday Gift
polishes.description: Vamp up the night with this rich, dark eggplant crelly, deepening with every coat. The perfect deep purple shade to seduce your next nail victim into wondering what you’re wearing—they’ll never know it’s Just Vamping.

polishes.name: Just Vamping
polishes.description: This holo concoction is no simple syrup. Lavender Syrup is a pale cool-toned purple packed with linear holographic pigment that sparkles with a periwinkle glow. Keep calm, relax, but don’t sip the nail polish!

polishes.name: Keep It Evergreen
polishes.description: Some things never go out of season. This deep evergreen shimmering metallic is no exception, with reflective sparkle and scattered holo that keep it standing out in the forest.

polishes.name: Knight Life
polishes.description: This polish is the only armour you’ll ever need to live the Knight Life. Cloaked in grey crushed holographic pigments, your nails will gleam like steel under candlelight—moody, modern, and made for your own round table.

polishes.name: Late Checkout
polishes.description: Dear customer, please note painting your nails with this mesmerizing polish may lead to a Late Checkout. This beautiful purple-indigo jelly shimmer shade dazzles under a flash with its golden reflective glitters. Pamper yourself with a couple coats and enjoy endless entertainment at your own pace, guaranteed.

polishes.name: Laven-duh
polishes.description: Can’t pick a nail polish colour? How about Laven-Duh. One thing is for sure, its rich application is opaque enough to get that pretty pastel purple coverage in just a couple creamy coats. The perfect shade for all the light-hearted purple lovers.

polishes.name: Lavender Syrup
polishes.description: This holo concoction is no simple syrup. Lavender Syrup is a pale cool-toned purple packed with linear holographic pigment that sparkles with a periwinkle glow. Keep calm, relax, but don’t sip the nail polish!

polishes.name: Lavender Syrup (birthday Gift
polishes.description: When an email comes in at the end of the workday… leave them Left On Red. Disregard the busy week you had and reward your nails with this bright red crème. The perfect hot red mani candidate with a self-levelling formula more satisfying than an auto-fillable .pdf.

polishes.name: Lemon Spritzer
polishes.description: Nails can’t go wrong with an order of Lemon Spritzer. Swipe on this pastel linear holographic shade for a sparkling soft yellow glow. You deserve that holo rejuvenation!

polishes.name: Lemon Sucker
polishes.description: You know what sucks… when there’s no holo! No one is sour about how packed with linear holographic pigment this deepened lemon-yellow polish is. Try Lemon Sucker in a gradient with neighbouring shades for an ultimate treat on your nails!

polishes.name: Life in Plastic
polishes.description: Put on your butterfly clips and break out that dream house: it’s time to return to a Life In Plastic. Apply a couple coats of this bright pink jelly polish to your nails and watch as its scattered holographic sparkle makes the 90s magic come alive. Isn’t it fantastic?

polishes.name: Linear Holo Taco
polishes.description: For automatic mani updates, enable the Lite Link. Sync your style to this artificial-intelligent shade that travels between bright shades of multichromatic teal and sea green. Careful, this polish is a gateway to mesmerizing formulas that will challenge the core code of boring nails.

polishes.name: Linear Holo Taco™
polishes.description: Transform any base colour into holo with this linear holographic topper for a stunning rainbow effect! Linear holo means that the tiny holographic pigments are close enough together that they form rainbows in the shape of a line. Watch it shift as you move your nails under the light!

polishes.name: Linear Holo Taco™ (birthday Gift
polishes.description: Transform any base colour into holo with this linear holographic top coat for a stunning rainbow effect! Linear holo means that the tiny holographic pigments are close enough together that they form rainbows in the shape of a line. Watch it shift as you move your nails under the light!

polishes.name: Lo-fi Lavender
polishes.description: Lo-fi shade, hi-fi holo. This lavender hues sets the mood for when you want a pixel-glitter escape from reality.

polishes.name: Long-lasting Base
polishes.description: Keep your manicure intact and prevent chipping with this long-lasting base coat that helps bond your nail polish to your nails. Love your holo for longer!

polishes.name: Lost in the Woods
polishes.description: Don’t forget your phone if you get Lost In The Woods. Point your flash at this deep hunter green linear holographic shade and find your way out of the forest. The perfect shade for getting lost.

polishes.name: Love Spell
polishes.description: One look at this nail polish and you’re under a Love Spell. Succumb to the charm of this powerful red-magenta shade and summon its magnetic features with the wave of your wand. Nail polish is just so attractive.

polishes.name: Lowkey Blushing
polishes.description: Set your heart on a pink so cozy and coveted we know you’re Lowkey Blushing. Apply two to three coats of this rich, warm blush crème to satisfy your pink mani cravings. With coverage so obvious, we think it likes you back.

polishes.name: Lunar Unicorn Skin
polishes.other_colors: Reflective, Iridescent, Multichrome, Flakie, Jelly, Topper
polishes.description: Love it or lust it? This delicate lilac linear holo with a silver magnetic pull blurs the lines just enough.

polishes.name: Lunar Unicorn Skin™
polishes.description: Did you know that unicorns exist on the dark side of the moon? Lunar Unicorn Skin is an iridescent flakie topper that brings some serious magic moon rocks to your mani. Over a dark base, the translucent asymmetrical flakies will shift in colour from a golden yellow flash to a hint of green. Over a light base, they light up in bright cyan, purple and pink.

polishes.name: Lust in Translation
polishes.description: Prepare to get pensive with Made Me Ink. This indigo jelly has a mind of its own, shifting between gleaming green iridescent flakes and silver scattered reflective glitter. With so much visual magic, you’ll find yourself lost in a sea of contemplation.

polishes.name: Made Me Ink
polishes.description: Prepare to get pensive with Made Me Ink. This indigo jelly has a mind of its own, shifting between gleaming green iridescent flakes and silver scattered reflective glitter. With so much visual magic, you’ll find yourself lost in a sea of contemplation.

polishes.name: Made Me Ink (birthday Gift
polishes.description: Your nails are ready for this Magenta Jelly! This deep magenta polish is packed with so much linear holographic pigment that you’ll be tempted to spread it on your toast (but don’t). Ever torn between pink and purple? This is the perfect in-between shade!

polishes.name: Magenta Jelly
polishes.description: Create magic 3D effects on your nails with our Magnetic Wand. Activate any of our magnetic polishes while wet with one of the two magnetic ends of this wand. Simply hover the wand over the nail while the polish dries, or paint your nail directly on top of the magnet while the polish sets.

polishes.name: Magical Mustache
polishes.description: Behold; the first nail polish to contain the same power as a magical human-grown mustache. Magical Mustache has a commanding presence with its rich walnut-brown crème shade that vibes perfectly on its own or paired with other shades (like Monstera). Rock the ‘stache with everything you do, and feel magical while you do it.

polishes.name: Magnetic Taco
polishes.description: Create your silver lining. Set in a clear base, this specialty magnetic topper lets you decide what trip you’re taking next—just swipe it on whatever landmark base colour you’re up for and magnetize to create the mani of a lifetime.

polishes.name: Magnetic Wand *free*
polishes.description: We’re not just glazing you. Pour on this syrupy brown jelly and get drenched in sweet, golden sparkle.

polishes.name: Matcha Maker
polishes.description: When you can’t decide which polish to wear… try a Matcha Maker! This refreshing light sage green crème polish will have you feeling the tranquili-tea on the first coat. Other people can leaf you alone, it’s time to sip back, relax and paint your nails.

polishes.name: Matte Taco
polishes.description: When the heat turns up, have a Meltdown. Get served a blue raspberry jelly with that just-melted drip… Can nails get brain freeze?

polishes.name: Matte Taco™
polishes.description: Sophisticated in matte! Top any manicure off with this matte top coat for a soft velvet matte finish. Try it over One-Coat Black for that classic matte black look, or over a special effect polish like a Unicorn Skin topper to unlock matte nail mysteries!

polishes.name: Menchie Cat Eye
polishes.description: Create a magnetizing mani in the blink of a Menchie Cat Eye. Coat your claws in two to three coats of this metallic sage green shade, then pounce on it with your Magnetic Wand and watch as a delicate green shimmer shines through and white-gold gleaming stripe takes the form of a cat eye. Effortless purrfection: achieved.

polishes.name: Menchie the Cat
polishes.description: As sparkling as her sweet personality and as pink as her nose! Menchie The Cat is a twinkling baby pink holographic glitter polish packed with micro, small, and medium-sized silver and pink holo glitters in a clear base. The three sizes of holo glitters give you purrfect coverage without needing to dab on the holo. Your nails will be feline good in this soft sparkling pink!

polishes.name: Midnight Marina
polishes.description: Late night mischief meets deep dockside blues in Midnight Marina. A creamy, sunbleached indigo crème that belongs by the shore.

polishes.name: Midnight Owl
polishes.description: Going to bed early hoo? Midnight Owl will keep you company. Stay up late polishing with this glittering deep indigo jelly shade for a mani fit with just the right amount of sparkle under the moonlight. It’s time for some midnight mani energy.

polishes.name: Midnight Spark
polishes.description: Let your nails be the sparks at midnight! This deep indigo holographic glitter polish is packed with micro, small, and medium-sized silver, indigo, and purple holographic glitters in a tinted vibrant purple-blue jelly base. Perfect for those who love their nails deep, dark and mysterious but want to give off some sparks this holoday season.

polishes.name: Milky White Shimmer
polishes.description: Introducing the only white polish legally allowed to be milky. Milky White Shimmer tells it like it is: a buildable sheer bright milky white formula with a fine white shimmer gleaming throughout. Whether you’re in the mood for a thin glaze in one coat, or a milkier frosting finish in two to three, this shimmer has your tips (mostly) covered.

polishes.name: Mint Mojito
polishes.collection: This light linear holographic aqua-mint shade is the perfect refresh-mint for your nail polish Pastel Rainbow (summer)
polishes.description: Time for your nails to turn over a new leaf with a fresh Mint Mojito manicure. This light linear holographic aqua-mint shade is the perfect refresh-mint for your nail polish collection. It’s simply mint to be on your nails!

polishes.name: Mint Money
polishes.description: Have your mo-mint with frosted metal mint nails! Mint Money is a unique icy green winter shade in a metallic foil finish. Your nails will thank you for making a smart invest-mint.

polishes.name: Miss Fire
polishes.description: Not releasing this shade earlier was admittedly a Miss Fire. Accent your look and adorn your tips in this vampy red garnet gemstone sparkler. Things are about to get heated.

polishes.name: Missed-shift
polishes.description: Shift into gear with a cool coat of car paint but for your nails. Missed-Shift is a multichrome polish that begins as a vibrant cool green and whips through shades of teal before striking purple at the right angle. Be careful not to pop the clutch with the coolest nails in the garage.

polishes.name: Mixed Emotions Thermal Stickers
polishes.description: The forest called, it wants its Modest Moss back. Step into the overgrown lush and enhance your natural beauty with this deep, mossy green polish. It’s easy to get lost in the green vibes with this enchanting green woodland shade.

polishes.name: Modest Moss
polishes.description: Wade into the calming waters of Moon Lagoon. This glacial pool aqua-green shade is lit from within, with an underglow of pink iridescent micro-shimmer that builds in two to three coats. Find serenity now and decide to sink or swim later.

polishes.name: Monstera
polishes.description: Being a plant parent is a full time job, so now at least your hands will look the part with Monstera. This deep forest green crème will grab eyes (not just at the nursery) and will keep you thinking about how many more plants you can fit in your space (you can definitely fit more). Polish watering not required.

polishes.name: Moon Lagoon
polishes.description: Wade into the calming waters of Moon Lagoon. This glacial pool aqua-green shade is lit from within, with an underglow of pink iridescent micro-shimmer that builds in two to three coats. Find serenity now and decide to sink or swim later.

polishes.name: Moon Lagoon (birthday Gift
polishes.description: Bathe under the crescent moonlight. This sheer sky blue jelly was summoned to apply like a dream with its orange iridescent micro-shimmer. A polish worth sacrificing for.

polishes.name: Moonlight Sacrifice
polishes.collection: Holo-Taco-X-Safiya-Volume-Two Holo Taco X Safiya Volume Ii (sep)
polishes.other_colors: Glow in the Dark, Holographic, Shimmer, Jelly

polishes.name: Moonlit Rodeo
polishes.description: Rodeo meets all-night rave with this striking shimmer. A purple jelly base, lit up with cyan blue micro-shimmer and a dustin’ of scattered holo, this finish glows like the moonlit sky. Saddle up––shimmer just got sultry.

polishes.name: Nature Calls
polishes.description: It’s late by the lake, the water’s warm, and the stars are out. You’re cozy by the fire, but you still gotta answer when Nature Calls. This mysteriously dark blue iridescent shimmers like moonlight on the lake, making a midnight dip the obvious answer.

polishes.name: Naughty List
polishes.description: **This is the last season this polish will be restocked. Once it sells out, it will join our Retirement Rack.** Just spoke to Santa, they said your naked nails are on the Naughty List. This deep red holo glitter polish is packed with micro, small and medium-sized silver and red holo glitters in a red jelly base for a sparkling ruby red finish. This polish is way better than a lump of coal.

polishes.name: Need I Say Mocha
polishes.description: New mindset just dropped and it’s Never Tide Down. Ride the sparkly wave of this unique turquoise jelly shade and discover treasure troves of iridescent flakes, glimmering crushed holo and holographic glitters. Set sail with no return date.

polishes.name: Need I Say Mocha?
polishes.description: Your nails, this polish, Need I Say Mocha? Dip into this mocha-infused shade of crushed holographic polish and get energized by its gleaming sparkle. Go ahead and paint for an instant pick-me up.

polishes.name: Need I Say Mocha? (birthday Gift
polishes.description: Your nails, this polish, Need I Say Mocha? Dip into this mocha-infused shade of crushed holographic polish and get energized by its gleaming sparkle. Go ahead and paint for an instant pick-me up.

polishes.name: Never Tide Down
polishes.description: New mindset just dropped and it’s Never Tide Down. Ride the sparkly wave of this unique turquoise jelly shade and discover treasure troves of iridescent flakes, glimmering crushed holo and holographic glitters. Set sail with no return date.

polishes.name: Never Tide Down (birthday Gift
polishes.description: Fall into some mani mischief by picking up a Nightshade. Get a dangerously delectable look in two to three coats of this rich eggplant purple polish. You can’t eat the polish, but you sure can slay with it.

polishes.name: Nightshade
polishes.description: Is that my Peach Tea?! This shade is packed with linear holographic pigments with rainbows that sparkle through a warm light peach-toned base. This tea is too holo to spill.

polishes.name: Nip in the Bud
polishes.description: Soft and subtle, Nip In The Bud is a muted pink inspired by a rose not quite in bloom. A little understated, a lot of potential––this classic crème is the perfect delicate flush.

polishes.name: No Opalogies
polishes.description: Is this the opal you’ve been searching for? This unapologetic pastel lavender jelly is packed with a kaleidoscope of iridescent flakies and micro-shimmer. Safe to say we’re not sorry?

polishes.name: No Smoking
polishes.description: Not to be a drag, but No Smoking allowed. Get into the habit of painting on this burnt olive brown shade, lit by its golden-green multichrome magnetic pull.

polishes.name: Not Milky White
polishes.description: No sheer polish here! We got your nails covered with this creamy opaque polish that is most definitely Not Milky White. Perfect for French tip manicures, nail art, or simply painting your nails straight-up white. This polish was reformulated in January 2021 for a smoother, more self-levelling application, and includes our NEW medium-width rounded crème brush.

polishes.name: Not Pressed
polishes.description: Show green haters you’re Not Pressed. Make a statement with this iconic crisp olive shade in two to three coats on your fingertips. The popular colours may be shaken, but you won’t be stirred.

polishes.name: Oat Couture
polishes.description: In this house of holo, we wear Oat Couture. This ivory oat-hued crushed holographic polish dazzles in the spotlight thanks to an infusion of holographic micro-flakes. Be on trend, get that fancy oat milk feeling.

polishes.name: Off the Grid
polishes.description: Go Off The Grid and you might just find the galaxy is at your fingertips. With only the magnetic amber glow of the campfire under a dark and twinkling iridescent sky, it’s easy to get lost in the sparkle.

polishes.name: Oh My Gourd
polishes.description: Oh My Gourd, your nails will be the brightest in the patch! Spice up your nails for fall harvest with this bold true orange crème polish. Its creamy coverage will leave you asking for another hayride.

polishes.name: One Melon Followers
polishes.description: Subscribe to this nail polish for One Melon Followers! This cantaloupe melon shade is bound to be popular for its smooth-talking crème application. Sorry but this shade is too good for a giveaway.

polishes.name: One-coat Black
polishes.description: This ultra-dark black polish is opaque in — you guessed it — just one coat! This makes for an easy one-coat application on the whole nail, or great for using in nail art when you’re reaching for the most opaque black possible!

polishes.name: Orange Drink
polishes.description: Time for some Vitamin Holo! This vibrant tangerine-orange polish is more packed with linear holographic pigment than 100% orange juice is packed with oranges. An Orange Drink breakfast for your nails is the perfect way to start the day!

polishes.name: Orbite Me
polishes.description: Claim your personal space with Orbite Me. Suit up in two to three coats of this luscious deep space burgundy crushed holo for a dark and dazzling look so killer it’ll take out life on another planet. Space vampires, get excited.

polishes.name: Overshadowed
polishes.collection: A contender for release in the After Party Declassified Tacos 001 (dec)
polishes.description: Introducing the polish that was statistically Overshadowed. A contender for release in the After Party Collection, this shade ultimately lost the popular vote. Prove the haters wrong by wearing this multi-faceted blue-grey metallic with a sprinkle of scattered holo and prove it too deserves to see the light.

polishes.name: Party of One Purple
polishes.description: You’re invited to a wild night in with Party Of One Purple. This light and bright violet purple shade is an easy people pleaser with its creamy coverage and happy hue. Some say this is the perfect shade of purple… once lost, now found.

polishes.name: Party Punch
polishes.description: It’s not a party unless holo was invited! This vibrant pink holographic glitter polish is packed with micro, small, and medium-sized silver and pink holographic glitters in a tinted pink jelly base. So pink it’s almost red — or is it red? Now your nails are a party conversation starter!

polishes.name: Peach Tea
polishes.description: Is that my Peach Tea?! This shade is packed with linear holographic pigments with rainbows that sparkle through a warm light peach-toned base. This tea is too holo to spill.

polishes.name: Peach Tea (birthday Gift
polishes.description: For those who enjoy the finer things, Pearl Grey is the moment. Two to three coats of this creamy glitter crelly, and you’ll have a latte sparkle that’s impossible to ignore. Pinkies up for this one.

polishes.name: Pearl Grey
polishes.description: Will your nails answer the Phantom Call? Take a risk by plunging into this hauntingly beautiful shimmering purple-mauve shade and resurface with an otherworldly underglow. With a powerful ethereal orange-to-pink micro-shimmer that shifts all the way through sunrise hues of yellow and green at hard angles (and a dash of scattered holo), she’s not like other purples.

polishes.name: Peely Base
polishes.description: Want to frequently change your mani or remove your nail polish easily without nail polish remover? It’s not a problem anymore with Peely Base! Apply 1 thin layer of this base coat under your manicure and you can peel it right off.

polishes.name: Peri-social
polishes.description: Become the Peri-Social butterfly of the group. After applying a couple coats of this perfect periwinkle to your tips, everybody will be after your mani recipe. You can thank us later ;)

polishes.name: Peridon't Bother Me
polishes.description: A lime green nail polish? It’s giving Peridon’t Bother Me. Strike up a conversation in this lime green sparkler, created to capture the peridot bright green birthstone of August. Its bold yellow to green shimmer base and green reflective glitters really pop off under the spotlight. If you’re wearing this lime green, nothing can dull your shine.

polishes.name: Phantom Call
polishes.description: Will your nails answer the Phantom Call? Take a risk by plunging into this hauntingly beautiful shimmering purple-mauve shade and resurface with an otherworldly underglow. With a powerful ethereal orange-to-pink micro-shimmer that shifts all the way through sunrise hues of yellow and green at hard angles (and a dash of scattered holo), she’s not like other purples.

polishes.name: Phantom Call (birthday Gift
polishes.description: When the invite says “bring snacks,” Picnic Party Taco delivers with a sweet mix of candy-coated pastel and iridescent hex glitters.

polishes.name: Pier Pressure
polishes.description: Don't fall for the Pier Pressure, go with the flow with this bright ocean-teal crème. Perfect for carefree coastal manis and days spent chasing waves.

polishes.name: Pink Fizz
polishes.description: Your nails will feel that holo buzz with Pink Fizz. This linear holographic is a cool-toned pink stunning sparkler that’s asking to be shown off on your fingertips. We pink this one will quench your thirst for holo!

polishes.name: Pink Himalayan Salt
polishes.description: A soft pink jelly that’s spilling over with silver reflective glitter. No need to throw it over your shoulder since the micro-holo brings good luck.

polishes.name: Pink Smoothing Base
polishes.description: Just a hint of pink, please. Smooth out uneven, dented or ridged nails with a wash of ridge-filling and priming soft pink base. Apply one coat as your base for smoother and more even nail polish application, or wear Pink Smoothing Base alone for that refreshed fresh bare nail look with an oh so barely there pink tint.

polishes.name: Pink Steel
polishes.description: Send a message of strength with nails of Pink Steel. Get your training started with this icy pale pink chrome polish in a formula that performs with one-coat coverage. Make sure you don’t get too distracted bench-pressing your bottles.

polishes.name: Pinky Swear
polishes.description: Did we catch you without any nail polish on? The horror! You better Pinky Swear it’s not true. Cover up in this sweet baby pink pastel and hide your naked nail tracks.Fun Fact: The name of this polish was selected by Holo Swatcher & Holo Royalty members!

polishes.name: Pirouette Pink
polishes.description: Cheers to rose gold holo! This holographic glitter polish is a must-have for rose gold lovers. Packed with micro, small, and medium-sized silver and gold holographic glitters in a tinted blush pink jelly base, this polish is truly a uniquely crafted cocktail of holo.

polishes.name: Play Rosé
polishes.description: Cheers to rose gold holo! This holographic glitter polish is a must-have for rose gold lovers. Packed with micro, small, and medium-sized silver and gold holographic glitters in a tinted blush pink jelly base, this polish is truly a uniquely crafted cocktail of holo.

polishes.name: Play Rosé (birthday Gift
polishes.description: There’s no shame in Playing The Field. This shifting multichrome magnetic refuses to be pinned down, flashing a different look with every move.

polishes.name: Playing the Field
polishes.description: Wear this shade for some Plumb Luck this holoday season. This unique shade of plum purple holo will captivate everyone at the Holoday party with its silver and magenta holographic glitters. No one wants plum pudding this Cristmas, we only want plum holo.

polishes.name: Playing with Sapphire
polishes.description: Go ahead, get Playing With Sapphire. Dive deep into this deep blue sapphire polish designed with September’s birthstone in mind. Revel at its glowing flakes and scattered holo that peek through a deep blue ocean jelly base for a smoldering bold sapphire finish. This one’s guaranteed to captivate the hearts of those wise enough to wear it.

polishes.name: Plumb Luck
polishes.description: Wear this shade for some Plumb Luck this holoday season. This unique shade of plum purple holo will captivate everyone at the Holoday party with its silver and magenta holographic glitters. No one wants plum pudding this Cristmas, we only want plum holo.

polishes.name: Plumb Luck (birthday Gift
polishes.description: Polar Opposites do attract. Give it a chance: this icy blue magnetic isn’t as cold-hearted as it appears.

polishes.name: Polar Opposites
polishes.description: May boring nails Rest In Peach! Coat your fingertips with this pastel peach crème that’s so killer it will send you into an early retirement.

polishes.name: Polar Princess
polishes.description: Why be an ice queen when you can be a Polar Princess? Time away from others is more time for you and your nails to enjoy the magic of this iridescent shimmer topper. One coat over a dark base shines with a pop of pink, travelling through a golden glimmer at an angle. Try it over a light base for a sweet icing look.

polishes.name: Pop Rocker
polishes.description: You can’t get this Pop Rocker out of your head. Top the charts with this bubblegum pink crushed holo bursting with iridescent indigo shimmer. Who’s sampling this pink track first?

polishes.name: Precious Cargo
polishes.description: This shade > whatever beauty mags told you was trending this summer. This bottle is about to become your most Precious Cargo with its stunning linear bronze holographic shift you just have to witness IRL. Check out its red, gold and green shifts as you roam through time zones.

polishes.name: Pretty Privilege
polishes.description: Some shades are just naturally gorgeous. Pretty Privilege is no exception, a soft pink magnetic that seems to always catch the light just right.

polishes.name: Private Villa
polishes.description: It’s time to fulfill your Private Villa fantasy. Whether lounging by the infinity pool in the sunshine or savouring that romantic dinner on the beach, this radiant red-pink jelly packed with golden sunset shimmer and pink reflective glitters will help set the scene.

polishes.name: Purple Flake Taco
polishes.description: More purple is always the answer. One coat of sparkling metallic violet flakes and suddenly, every mani you pick is your favourite.

polishes.name: Purple Flakie Holo Taco
polishes.collection: Purple Flakie Holo Taco is a limited edition flakie topper from the Holo Taco 1st Anniversary 1st Anniversary (summer)
polishes.description: Every nail deserves to be the holo queen! Purple Flakie Holo Taco is a limited edition flakie topper from the Holo Taco 1st Anniversary Collection that transforms your nails from boring birthday to purple holo party.

polishes.name: Purple Slushie
polishes.description: Pour one out for Purple Slushie! (but don’t, because the holo is too precious). This vivid polish is a true purple shade packed with linear holographic pigment for a super-intense royal linear holo flame. Your nails are the holo queen now!

polishes.name: Purple with Envy
polishes.description: Boring nails are jealous of how many colours Purple With Envy can be all at once. This multichrome polish starts as a royal purple and transforms through shades of indigo, blue and magenta, reaching as far as gold. Haters will say it’s photoshop!

polishes.name: Queen's Curse
polishes.description: With this polish you are cursed… to never have boring nails. Queen’s Curse is a royal regent purple magnetic polish, a captivating ruler of its kind. Exercise your power with your magic wand and conjure up a magic purple spell on your tips.

polishes.name: Quick-dry Base
polishes.description: Don’t lose your patience, get Quick-Dry Base. Get your manicure off to a smooth start in no time by applying this protective base coat that grips onto your polish and dries down quickly so you can get to living your best life.

polishes.name: Rage Bait
polishes.description: It’s easy to fall for this Rage Bait. Catch this fiery thermal polish in a blazing coral shade when the air is chilled, or turn up the heat and watch it change to a bold tangerine hue. Jealousy is just a reaction and we’re here to serve it on repeat.

polishes.name: Rainbow Flood
polishes.description: What do you get when you mix all the colours of the holographic rainbow? A Rainbow Flood. This is no science experiment, it’s just what mother holo nature intended: a mix of all seven shades of our vibrant rainbow linear holographic polishes. The result is a stunning eggplant purple shade with a holographic depth that keeps on playing.

polishes.name: Rainbow Snow
polishes.collection: A must-have in every nail polish Holoday Collection (winter)
polishes.description: There’s snow place like holo! A must-have in every nail polish collection, this silver holographic glitter polish is packed with micro, small, and medium-sized silver holographic glitters for the ultimate classic sparkling holo mani. Every single glitter reflects a rainbow — only 100% holo here!

polishes.name: Red Flake Taco
polishes.description: What’s got shine, spice, and everything nice? A Red Flake Taco. Add a dash of this metallic red-magenta foil flake topper to your manicure for something a little spicy this season.

polishes.name: Red Licorice
polishes.description: This one will have your holo heart! This bright red polish is a new classic, packed with linear holographic pigment for a super-intense linear holo flame. Bright n’ juicy like strawberry Red Licorice — but don’t lick it!

polishes.name: Reflective Taco
polishes.description: This Taco knows how to light up a room. Add a coat of Reflective Taco to any manicure and when that spotlight hits, your nails will look like diamonds. Activated by direct light at specific angles, this special topper is made of reflective pigments that commands attention like a stop-sign at night. Don’t get too distracted!

polishes.name: Rest in Peach
polishes.description: May boring nails Rest In Peach! Coat your fingertips with this pastel peach crème that’s so killer it will send you into an early retirement.

polishes.name: Rest in Peach (birthday Gift

polishes.name: Resting Witch Face

polishes.name: Resting Witch Face (birthday Gift
polishes.description: Your new Ride Or Diamond nail polish. We felt the pressure to capture the pure sparkle of April’s birthstone in this dazzling diamond shade. Packed with all the types of pure holo we could fit in the bottle: linear, flakes, glitters, plus a dusting of silver reflective glitter. This diamond was made in the lab (we are so real for that).

polishes.name: Ride or Diamond
polishes.description: Imagine not being picked for a team not just once… but twice. Rose Gold Flake Taco has been on the sidelines since the Tea Crèmes Collection and the Down to Earth Bundle. Do yourself a favour and claim your coat of this beautiful rose gold metallic topper that pairs so pretty with the rest of our shades. You can thank us later.

polishes.name: Rip Bestie
polishes.collection: Holo-Taco-X-Safiya-Volume-Two Holo Taco X Safiya Volume Ii (sep)
polishes.description: Bury your bestie in this mysteriously beautiful blackened plum polish, lit with iridescent micro-shimmer and scattered holo. True friendship, hand in hand.

polishes.name: Rose Gold Flake Taco
polishes.description: Imagine not being picked for a team not just once… but twice. Rose Gold Flake Taco has been on the sidelines since the Tea Crèmes Collection and the Down to Earth Bundle. polishes.name: Work Bestie
polishes.description: The best part of the day is catching up with your Work Bestie. You, your nails and this warm and bold purple crème nail polish: we know you understand the assignment. Teamwork makes the crème-work!

polishes.name: World's First
polishes.description: So revolutionary, some might wonder if you’re wearing the World’s First chrome polish… or maybe that’s just our conspiracy theory. Apply one coat of this bright silver lustrous chrome polish and you’re bringing chrome back, baby.

polishes.name: Wreath Havoc Taco
polishes.description: Style your Zyler to win best in show. Swipe on two to three coats of Zyler Cat Eye, a dapper metallic copper shade, then wave your Magnetic Wand and watch as its red-orange shimmer rises in full force, much like Zyler’s majestic irises. Your nails have never looked so dignif-eyed.

polishes.name: Zyler Cat Eye (birthday Gift
polishes.description: As bold as his royal orange coat yet deep like his inquisitive soul! Zyler The Cat is a rich rusted orange holographic glitter polish full of micro, small, and medium-sized silver and copper holo glitters in a deep orange tinted jelly base. The three sizes of holo glitters give you purrfect coverage without needing to dab on the holo. Your nails are the king of cats with these copper tips!This polish was reformulated in July 2023 to improve stability while maintaining its original deep orange glitter shade.

polishes.name: Zyler the Cat
polishes.description: Are you ready for a transformative experience? Change is rarely comfortable, but I believe in you. the glowing sky before the sun sets. a blinding red and orange holo flakie bomb.
